correct_completion: visitors can come on Sunday too.
full_sentence: The museum is open every day, so visitors can come on Sunday too.
acceptable_variants: they can plan a visit at any time of the week.
families can visit whenever they like.

options.text: the entrance is at the back of the building.
options.why_wrong: This gives a location detail, which does not follow as a result of the museum being open every day.

explanation: 'So' introduces a result that follows from the first clause. The completion must describe what becomes possible because of the opening pattern, so a result about visiting times is the logical choice.
translation: Музей відкритий щодня, тож відвідувачі можуть прийти і в неділю.
